bounded_hypothesis: Among confidence-qualified monomer structural dark families (mean pLDDT >= 0.70, length >= 100 aa; N = 2,838) conditioned on the 12,556 verified 90%-sequence-cluster representative members in 04_cluster/clusters.tsv and restricted to families with >= 2 distinct refined-MAG dRep 95% ANI species clusters carrying complete 4-flank (+-2 CDS) Bakta-mapped windows on SHA-256 and Bakta-log verified contigs (Tier 1 exact coordinates, n = 72 in the 300-family stratified pilot; Tier 2 exact or unique same-strand/frame/overlap 3-prime-stop matches, n = 133), test (a) within-arm flanking KEGG KO recurrence enrichment relative to uniform random eligible 4-flank positions on the same host contigs and (b) whether low-query-TM families (K, qTM < 0.5 against PDB and AFDB; n = 1,031) differ from fold-matched sequence-dark families (Q \ K, qTM >= 0.5; n = 1,807) in family-level background-adjusted excess recurrence (E_fam = C_fam^obs - mu_fam^pos and E_fam^(R) = R_fam^obs - rho_fam^pos) and raw recurrence (C_fam in {0, 1}, R_fam in [0, 1]), conditioning on species breadth, flank KO annotation opportunity, sequence length, mean pLDDT, and GTDB-Tk R232 host phylum group, with no inference of novel folds, operon co-transcription, gene expression, or adaptive mechanisms.
optional_improvements: O1 (Species-block bootstrap and conditional-exchangeability phrasing): In scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py:859-883, the species-cluster bootstrap resamples the 144 unique dRep species clusters by reweighting each family's fixed pre-computed E_fam and C_fam (w_f = sum(sampled_sp[s])/len(f_sp)) and taking the unstratified arm difference (+0.0989 baseline) rather than recomputing multi-species KO recurrence (>= 2 distinct resampled species) or the primary Mantel-Haenszel stratified estimator (-0.0648), while 21/144 species (8 across both arms), 13/57 named genera, and 19/56 named GTDB families are shared across >= 2 Tier 1 families. State conditional exchangeability and cross-family independence as identifying assumptions and sensitivity analyses rather than 'verified' properties (DOSSIER.md:152,154), and note that 4-group R232 phylum stratification and 9-pair exact phylum matching provide coarse taxonomic conditioning rather than full phylogenetic covariance control.

O2 (Full-cohort power statement): DOSSIER.md:225 asserts '>= 80% power for |Delta_MH(E_fam)| >= 0.12-0.15 at alpha = 0.05' for the 1,461-family Gate 3 full run without a saved power script or finite-population variance derivation (scaling pilot SEs of 0.0937-0.0965 by the expected 163.4 K and 172.3 Q\K Tier 1 sample sizes gives an infinite-population normal-approximation MDE_80% of 0.119-0.138, but the 1,461 Gate 3 families are a finite catalogue from which 300 were already sampled). Provide the explicit variance-scaling formula and finite-population caveat or remove the uncomputed power claim.

O3 (Mobilome 0/30 keyword flag vs housekeeping/chromosomal claims): best_ko_mobilome_flag (scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py:99-116,189-197) checks an 11-keyword substring list only on flanks carrying best_recurrent_ko. Report 0/30 strictly as absence of phage/transposase keywords among top recurrent KOs rather than proof that mobile elements are absent or that all 30 contexts are core housekeeping and metabolic genes (DOSSIER.md:166,226).

reason: All five prior critical issues (C1-C5) from round6/h2_review1 are resolved in frozen h2_v3 (Slurm jobs 53712511 and 53713357, verified across all 65 snapshot files and 3,800 SHA-256-pinned input files): (1) locus-level eligibility is enforced prior to KO aggregation over identical eligible species sets so R_fam in [0, 1] for all 300 families and ineligible families are coded -1; (2) 100% of dRep species clusters (5,438/5,438) and Gate 3 families (1,461/1,461) are joined to verified GTDB-Tk R232 taxonomy via Cdb.csv and Wdb.csv, true nucleotide contig lengths (contig_len_bp > 0) and window completeness govern outcome-independent primary-locus selection, and all four multivariable OLS/HC3 and MLE/L2-penalized logistic regressions converge at full rank (9/9) with finite bounded SEs; (3) Part (a) samples pseudo-focal positions strictly from same-contig gene indices satisfying the identical 4-flank mapping gate (showing +35.97 pp and +26.08 pp within-arm enrichment in K and Q\K, both p = 0.0002), while Part (b) tests the between-arm contrast on background-adjusted excess E_fam via common-support stratified permutation (Delta_MH = -0.0648, p = 0.4907 in Tier 1; +0.0119, p = 0.8678 in Tier 2), caliper matching with explicit balance diagnostics, and converged regressions; (4) 685/685 available bins pass cryptographic forward-strand nucleotide SHA-256 and Bakta .log orig-id verification while 24 missing-annotation bins are explicitly separated; and (5) the 90%-cluster representative population basis and interpretive bounds are explicitly stated. Remaining points regarding the fixed-outcome weighting in the species-block bootstrap, uncomputed full-cohort power scaling, and keyword-only mobilome flagging are non-blocking documentation caveats captured in O1-O4.
